hero.headline: REDMOND'S TRUSTED
hero.subtitle: Family-owned and operated at 1520 NW 6th St. From wheels, tires, and precision alignments to 4x4 suspension lifts, driveline fabrication, and full auto repair.

servicesSubtitle: Built on honest service, competitive pricing, and state-of-the-art shop equipment.

services.title: Tires & Custom Wheels
services.summary: Same-day mounting, balancing, flat repair, and rotation. Authorized dealer for Toyo, Nitto, Falken, BFGoodrich, and Yokohama.

services.title: Precision Alignments
services.summary: Equipped with high-precision Hunter & Dannmar alignment racks for lifted trucks, 4x4 rigs, daily drivers, and classic muscle cars.

services.title: Suspension & Lift Kits
services.summary: Leveling kits, full 4x4 suspension lifts, shocks, struts, steering upgrades, and heavy-duty truck & offroad accessories.

services.title: Driveline Fabrication & Balancing
services.summary: Home of KPD (Khaos Performance Drivelines) — in-house driveline fabrication, high-speed balancing, and repair.

products.name: 4-Wheel Precision Laser Alignment
products.description: Complete Hunter laser alignment inspection and adjustment for cars, SUVs, and pickups.

products.name: Truck Front Leveling Kit + Alignment
products.description: Front leveling kit installation plus full post-lift 4-wheel alignment.

reviews.headline: Rated 4.8 Stars by Central Oregon Drivers

items.name: Sarah A
items.text: This family owned business is wonderful! I got my alignment done there today and they had the best price in town. They also have a really cool lobby with racing merch!

items.name: Paul Corbin
items.text: Great place with honest and friendly staff...recommend 100% ... specially if you have a 4x4 ... tires, suspension and other goodies.

items.name: wrangler howe
items.text: Best experience I’ve ever had buying wheels and tires they ordered everything I dropped off the pickup and it was done same day won’t go anywhere else.
